title: ALMA Observations of Atomic Carbon [C I] ( <SUP> 3 </SUP> P <SUB> 1 </SUB> → <SUP> 3 </SUP> P <SUB> 0 </SUB>) and Low-J CO Lines in the Starburst Galaxy NGC 1808
question: How does atomic carbon [C I](1-0) relate to low-J CO lines, molecular gas mass and outflow in the central 1 kpc of the starburst galaxy NGC 1808?

evidence.quote: (cite: Jia19) have shown that, for a sample of 15 nearby galaxies, including Seyfert and starburst galaxies

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, continuum subtraction, tclean cube imaging, feather with TP for band 8

recipe.goal: Make moment maps and line fluxes/luminosities
recipe.method: immoments with no masking for integrated intensity; masked moments 1 and 2; L' from SDR92 formula

recipe.goal: CND column density and abundance in LTE
recipe.method: LTE optically thin N_CO and N_CI from mean 3'' aperture spectra; masses via XCO
RADEX grid in N, Tk, nH2; match CO(3-2)/(1-0), CO(2-1)/(1-0), [C I]/CO(1-0) ratios within 3 sigma
key_parameters: dV = 25 km/s, T_bg = 2.73 K, LVG escape probability

recipe.method: Azimuthally averaged ratio profiles in elliptical rings; pixel power-law least-squares fits W_CO = a W_CI^b
[C I] smoothed to CO(1-0) resolution; PVDs along dust lanes; <10% of flux in non-circular motions; Ek=Mv^2/2

answer_key.quantity: M_CI in CND at Tex=50 K

evidence.quote: the mean C I/H$_2$ abundance ratio in the CND is $N_\mathrm{CI}/N_\mathrm{H_2}=M_\mathrm{CI}/(6M_\mathrm{H_2})\sim6\times10^{-5}$
the mean value over the rings within a radius of $20\ensuremath{''}$ is $r_{21}=0.21\pm0.01$
The mean intensity ratio over the rings in the central radius $20\ensuremath{''}$ region is $0.18\pm0.04$.

answer_key.quantity: CO(1-0) vs [C I] power-law index b
Outflow C I mass upper limit
Total C I mass central 1 kpc
